model.title: Proposal for a REGULATION OF THE EUROPEAN PARLIAMENT AND OF THE COUNCIL on the Farm Sustainability Data Network (codification)

summary.text: This proposal aims to establish a network for collecting and sharing data about farming practices and sustainability on farms. It would help monitor how agricultural activities affect the environment and resource use across the region.
